findings.evidence: `toSSetObjEquiv_toSSet_map_app` exists at TopAdj.lean:65 for exactly this step, and `toTop_map_toTopObjMk` in this PR already rewrites with it instead of relying on `rfl`.
findings.fix: Replace the `rfl` with `rw [NatTrans.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, TauCeti.TopCat.toSSetObjEquiv_toSSet_map_app, ContinuousMap.comp_apply]` (the same chain used in `toTop_map_toTopObjMk`), then close with `rfl` against `toTopObjMk`.
findings.issue: `apply_toTopObjMk` ends with `rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]; rfl`. The `rfl` silently unfolds `NatTrans.comp_app`, the composite applied to `x`, and `TopCat.toSSetObjEquiv` of `toSSet.map F`.

findings.evidence: The goal after the `rw` is stated as `toSSetObjEquiv` of a composite natural transformation, while `h` is stated as `gᵢ (toTopObjMk x w)`; the two match only up to unfolding.
findings.fix: Rewrite with `NatTrans.comp_app`, `ConcreteCategory.comp_apply`, `TauCeti.TopCat.toSSetObjEquiv_toSSet_map_app` and `ContinuousMap.comp_apply` before `exact`, or derive both sides from `apply_toTopObjMk` once it is moved here.
findings.issue: Same problem in `toTop_hom_ext`: after `rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]`, `exact h n x w` only closes the goal by unfolding `(unit.app X ≫ toSSet.map gᵢ).app _ x` to `gᵢ (toTopObjMk x w)`.

findings.evidence: After the `rw` chain, the left side has the form `j.app _ ((𝟙 _) x)` and the right side is `j.app _ x`.
findings.fix: Add a `ConcreteCategory.id_apply` (or `types_id_apply`) rewrite instead of the bare `rfl`.
findings.issue: `whiskerRight_app_app_objEquiv_symm_id` ends with `rfl` after `CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id`. That `rfl` relies on `(𝟙 _ : X.obj _ ⟶ _) x` unfolding to `x`.

summary: The proofs are mostly robust and well structured, but three of them close by unfolding definitions through the adjunction unit, `toSSet.map` and `𝟙` in `Type`, with no named lemma and no comment.
